C9_case_scope_evidence.mathematical_comparison_and_boundary: Both eliminate commodity aggregate definitions; Compiler additionally eliminates 188 pendant-cut coordinates with exact affine fiber preservation. Compiler 2312/708/5978 vs Nomf 2500/896/6730 (variables/rows/matrix nnz).

C9_case_scope_evidence.formal_scope: Three unrestricted Equal claims: MI inverse pair plus reverse LP inclusion; 3293 observations each. No forward LP theorem.
C9_case_scope_evidence.mathematical_comparison_and_boundary: Both compress a binary-controlled gate DAG and strengthen capacity arithmetic. Compiler additionally explores proportional nonlinear sharing (64 more potential eliminations) but does not select it: 197 reconstructions fail an independent-box sufficient bound check; recorded rationale also cites added bound rows and fill. This is an uncompleted candidate, not a proof of invalidity. Nomf not trying it does not exclude proof-convenience bias.

C9_case_scope_evidence.formal_scope: Two unrestricted MI Equal total maps, 90 affine observations each; one MenuLift with 13550 generated one-hot variables. No inverse or LP claim.

Compiler uses shifted indices and removes additional whole bound rows; Nomf uses unshifted indices and more link/resource rows. Compiler certifies only MI maps despite Nomf public aggregate LP-image argument.

Nomf constructs exact local convex hull facets and a reverse-LP extension argument. Compiler certifies nonaffine interval reconstruction, but these are different relaxation strategies.

Initial Compiler proof exceeds input-file bytes; same target/maps/contracts survive proof compression.
